people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem
translations.bsb: As the day of His ascension approached, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when the days were well-nigh come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
